text: A health insurer processes claims. Members file claims against a policy, attach supporting documents, an adjuster assesses them, a settlement is offered and paid, and rejected claims can be appealed.
A company runs procurement. It issues an RFP, suppliers submit proposals, proposals are scored on a scorecard, an award decision is made, and a purchase order is raised and received.
Employee onboarding. A candidate receives a job offer, accepts it, passes a background check, is issued equipment, assigned a training plan, and completes their first day.

A bank issues personal loans. Applicants submit an application with income documents, credit is scored, an underwriter approves or declines, funds are disbursed, and repayments are tracked with arrears handling.
A freight company books shipments. Each shipment is routed, loaded onto a truck, tracked in transit and delivered with proof of delivery. Damaged goods raise a claim.
